news.headline: Delcath Systems to Host Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Call
news.summary: Delcath announced it will report financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 via a conference call and webcast on August 6, 2026 at 8:30 AM ET, its next major disclosure of HEPZATO KIT commercial performance.

news.headline: Delcath Systems (DCTH): Analyst Consensus And 73% Potential Upside Drive Investor Interest
news.summary: Wall Street coverage of Delcath remains a Strong Buy consensus (five Buy ratings, no holds or sells) with an average price target in the high-teens to low-$20s, implying substantial upside versus the stock's mid-$12 trading level in late July 2026.

news.headline: Delcath Systems, Inc. Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Delcath granted RSUs totaling 17,000 shares as material inducements to four new employees who joined the company in May and June 2026, in compliance with Nasdaq's inducement-grant disclosure rule, with awards vesting over three years.

news.headline: BTIG Raises Delcath Systems Price Target to $17 from $16, Maintains Buy
news.summary: BTIG analyst Marie Thibault raised her price target on Delcath while reiterating a Buy rating, part of a broader run of bullish sell-side notes ahead of the company's Q2 2026 earnings report.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 2 Clinical Trial of HEPZATO in Liver-Dominant Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: The first patient was dosed at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in Delcath's global randomized Phase 2 DELUMA trial, which will enroll about 90 patients with liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer across more than 20 US/European sites to test HEPZATO plus standard of care versus standard of care alone.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings call
catalysts.detail: Delcath will report financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 and host a conference call at 8:30 AM ET on August 6, 2026; investors will watch HEPZATO volume growth and progress toward the at-least-$100M full-year 2026 revenue guidance after a Q1 print of $25.0M.

catalysts.label: Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
catalysts.detail: Delcath management is scheduled to participate in the Canaccord Genuity Annual Growth Conference in Boston, an investor venue where the company typically updates on HEPZATO commercial trajectory and pipeline progress.

catalysts.label: Phase 2 colorectal cancer trial (hPFS) interim/topline data
catalysts.detail: Delcath's randomized Phase 2 trial of HEPZATO plus trifluridine-tipiracil/bevacizumab versus standard of care alone in liver-dominant metastatic colorectal cancer is enrolling across a planned 26 sites, with interim hepatic progression-free survival results anticipated in late 2027.

catalysts.label: DELUMA Phase 2 breast cancer trial data
catalysts.detail: Following the July 2026 first-patient dosing, topline data from the roughly 90-patient Phase 2 DELUMA trial of HEPZATO in liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer is not expected for at least one to two years given enrollment just began.

pulse: Delcath is a commercial-stage interventional oncology company generating growing revenue from HEPZATO KIT (FDA-approved for hepatic-dominant metastatic uveal melanoma) and CHEMOSAT in Europe, with FY2026 guidance of at least $100 million in revenue after a 26%-growth Q1. The company is expanding HEPZATO into new tumor types, having dosed its first patient in the DELUMA Phase 2 breast cancer trial in July 2026 alongside an already-enrolling colorectal cancer Phase 2 study, while sell-side sentiment stays firmly bullish (Strong Buy consensus, price targets in the high-teens/low-$20s) against a mid-$12 stock price. The next major catalyst is the Q2 2026 earnings call on August 6, 2026, followed by a Canaccord Genuity investor conference appearance on August 11, with investors focused on HEPZATO procedure volume trends and confirmation of the back-half acceleration needed to hit full-year guidance.
